name: Bailite

traits.d: When a skill or an Ultimate hits a target, reduces the target's Earth Resistance by -3% of ATK for 20 s. Stacks up to 10 times.

skills.d: Deploys a smokescreen that obscures vision. Targets cannot be aimed at through the smoke.
Lowers its chassis and grips the ground. During this state, basic attacks are replaced with cannon fire that consumes EP and deals AoE damage.
Launches Cozite to hover around itself. When a team member uses a Skill or Ultimate, Cozite performs a coordinated attack. Lasts 15 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Unleashes a devastating strike. Overflowing energy remains in the crater, dealing continuous damage.
Wields the power of earth to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Launches Cozite to hover around this Aniimo. When the party casts a skill or Ultimate, they perform coordinated attacks. Each hit deals additional area damage equal to 10% of the original damage. Lasts 15 s.

log: Their upper and lower bodies can rotate independently, allowing Bailites to survey their surroundings with ease and transform into turrets to drive off opponents.

name: Baleetle

traits.d: Increases ATK by 12% for 15s when entering battle.
Moving and using skills builds [Overload Energy] . When [Overload Energy] is full, the next skill gains 40% bonus damage.

skills.d: Raises the stone ball and rolls forward, dealing a large amount of damage.
Spins around to deal damage to a target in front. Each hit increases damage by 8% for 20 s, stacking up to 4 times.

innate.d: Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

log: They never go anywhere without their stone balls. The constant rolling makes the balls rounder, but there's something else about it...

name: Besauce

traits.d: When casting a skill with less than 20 EP, restores 500% of EP regen EP.

skills.d: Releases a current of electricity, damaging targets ahead.
Keeps playing, sending sound waves forward to damage targets.
Restores 15 Energy and restores 100% of EP regen Energy per second for 12 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Creates an independent music space and deals damage to the targets within the space, lowering their Lightning resistance by 30% of EP regen for 30 s.
Wields the power of lightning to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Restores 15 Energy and restores 100% of EP regen Energy per second for 12 s. If the Skill key is pressed again at the precise moment, an additional 10 Energy is restored.

log: Troubled by the beat of its own heart, Besauce constantly searches for rhythms to drown it out. It loves to groove to music and has a passion for avant-garde music.

name: Blazen

traits.d: After skills land 6 critical hits, becomes [Overcharged] , immediately gaining a shield equal to 5% HP. All skills cost 12 less EP, but UP cannot be gained. Lasts 6 s.
After using 3 skills, increases the next skill's damage by 50%.

skills.d: Channels the power of lightning and strikes the target with a three-hit claw combo. This skill grants an additional 50% CRIT Rate.
Dashes toward the target with electricity and cannot be blocked during the dash. Restores 5 EP when landing a critical hit.
Channels the power of lightning, sending a lightning claw mark surging forward that deals up to 3 hits to the target. This skill grants an additional 50% CRIT Rate.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Leaps up at high speed, gathers electricity, then slams down onto the target and enters the [Overcharged] state.
Wields the power of lightning to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Dashes toward the target while electrified and cannot be blocked during the dash. Critical hits restore 5 energy. When used while [Overcharged] , energy cost is reduced by an additional 3 points.

log: They use their special fur to capture charged particles in the air to produce and store electricity.

name: Bolty

traits.d: After skills land 6 critical hits, becomes [Overcharged] , immediately gaining a shield equal to 5% HP. All skills cost 12 less EP, but UP cannot be gained. Lasts 6 s.
After using 3 skills, increases the next skill's damage by 50%.

skills.d: Channels the power of lightning, swinging its tail to attack targets ahead. This skill grants 50% additional critical rate.
While electrified, charges toward the target to deal damage.

innate.d: Wields the power of lightning to attack targets at close range.

log: They live among the trees. When they attack, golden sparks flash from their tails with crackling electric sounds. Agile and quick on their feet, they are very difficult to catch.

name: Bonesky

traits.d: When dealing damage to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] , increases Crit Rate of that damage by 15% .
Increases ATK by 12% for 15s when entering battle.
CRIT Damage increased by 40%.

skills.d: Lunges forward and spins to create a magic field that fires 3 ice blades for 3 hits, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] .

Throws an ice blade forward, dealing damage to targets in range and applying stacks of [Ice Debuff] . The ice blade continuously consumes energy while spinning, and pressing the Skill button again recalls it.

innate.d: Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

log: An energetic pup with a pair of big ears. The ice-bone bow tie on its chest is its favorite toy. It hates Emberpups that don't respect personal space.

name: Bouldus

traits.d: [Rock Piles] created by Bouldus can be destroyed by Waleetle 's [Stone Ball Drift] , releasing shock waves and applying [Disintegration] to the target. [Disintegration]: Each stack reduces Earth Resistance by 7.5% of ATK and Movement Speed by 5% for 20 s, up to 6 stacks.

skills.d: Charges briefly in place, then rushes at the target and slams into it, dealing damage and creating 4 [Rock Piles] around the target.

Transforms into a ball that moves forward automatically for 15 s. Direction can be adjusted. Hitting an enemy deals damage, while bouncing off a wall deals AoE damage equal to 15 Might to nearby targets. Jump is available in the Rolling Ball state, dealing AoE damage equal to 20 Might on landing. Jump cooldown: 5 s.
Throws a clay ball in a straight line in the direction faced, dealing damage on hit and applying Disintegration effect.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Spins rapidly across the ground, pulling in debris before detonating violently. On explosion, deals AoE damage and generates 6 [Rock Piles] around the Bouldus.
Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: After charging in place for a short while, rushes at the target and slams into it with its body, dealing damage and stunning the target for 1 seconds, then generates 4 Rock Piles around the target.

log: A stone ball that had stayed with Baleetle day and night. It gained consciousness after a rough bump, tired of being controlled, it swallowed Baleetle and could finally move by its own will.

name: Bubbeep

traits.d: Automatically restores 1 points of [Bubble Energy] per second. Each time your own skill deals damage to a target, you also recover an additional 3 points, up to a maximum of 10 points stored. When you cast [Baa Baa Healing], it consumes 10 points and grants an extra 12% .

skills.d: Fires a bubble beam that pierces through allies and opponents, dealing damage to targets and applying a shield to allies along its path. The shield equals 7.0% of the caster's Max HP and lasts 10 s.
While floating and moving, heals all allies within range for 12% of the caster's Max HP over 6 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

log: It stretches its leafy feathers with lazy ease, always chewing away as it turns algae and slime into floating bubbles. One light hop, and off it drifts, riding the bubbles like a little boat in the breeze.

name: Budclaw

traits.d: Builds Momentum when dealing damage, up to 6 stacks. Momentum gain is doubled while tunneling. At max stacks, BREAK efficiency increases by 30% for 20 s.
While in Tunnel state, restore 2 Energy when dealing Damage to targets. Can be triggered once per second at most.
Restores 2 Energy when dealing Skill Damage to a target. Can be triggered once per second at most.

skills.d: Spins leaves around itself, dealing damage for 5.5 s.
Fires an energy beam in the direction the camera is facing, continuously dealing damage to targets within range. Consecutive hits gradually increase its Might.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

log: Mating for life, they're always found in pairs. The heartbloom atop their shells indicates their state of happiness.

name: Budsquire

traits.d: Increases Grass damage by 12%.
Each skill used grants 1 stack of [Sword Dance] , up to 4 stacks, lasting 15 s. Each basic attack costs 1 stack of [Sword Dance] to deal 180% extra damage.

skills.d: Enters a defensive stance, reducing damage taken by 20% . While in this state, it counters when attacked. If attacked just as the skill is used, its critical rate increases by 30% for 15 s.
Thrusts toward the target. On hit, increases this Aniimo's Crit Rate by 15% for 15 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of grass to attack targets at close range.

log: The timid crybabies can also rise up against enemies when cornered. The buds on their heads will blossom as they do so.

name: Bulbly

traits.d: Teammates who receive this Aniimo's skill buff also gain a 15% of ATK Lightning boost for 20 s.
Increases healing by 10%.
While in battle, the next skill grants an additional 25 Ultimate Points. Can trigger once every 15s.

skills.d: Quickly retreats, leaving behind a jellyfish clone that releases a wave of Lightning energy to attack targets and slow them by 15% for 10 s.
Fires an energy beam. Hold the skill button to keep firing, damaging targets within range and healing Lightning-type teammates within range for 2% HP every second.

innate.d: Wields the power of lightning to attack targets from a distance.

log: Their first reaction to everything is to escape, and their bulb-like organs indicate whether they are healthy.

name: Celestis

traits.d: When basic attacks hit a target, increases the next skill's damage by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times.
For 5 s after using a skill, basic attack hits deal additional damage equal to 6 Might.

skills.d: Flies overhead, dropping stars that damage targets. Hitting the same target 3 times increases this Aniimo's EP recovery rate by 10% for 10 s.
Shoots stars to attack a target, dealing damage.

innate.d: Wields dark power to attack targets from a distance.

log: They love food! When they search the forest for food, the glowing stars on their heads are often mistaken for comets. They like hoarding food, adorning their nest with it.

name: Cheekie

traits.d: After casting 3 skills, enhances the next skill used during Icebreaker and adds an extra effect. When HP is below 75% , increases BREAK efficiency by 20% . When HP is below 50% , increases BREAK efficiency by 40% .

skills.d: Leaps toward the target and slams down, dealing circular AoE damage. When enhanced, gains an Ice Shield equal to 10% of max HP and creates a ring-shaped Ice Prison around the target for 8 s. Recast to cancel the Ice Prison.
Charges in the selected direction, knocking back targets and dealing damage. Hitting any target consumes 10% of current HP.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

log: People often mistake the circles on their cheeks for eyes. They love to gather in groups on the shore, feeling safe only when they huddle closely with their companions.

name: Chirpi

traits.d: Reduces the EP cost of all skills by 18%.
When switching Aniimo in battle, restores 2500% of ATK EP to the next Chirpi family member switched in. Triggers once every 20 s at most.

skills.d: Releases an air vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.
Plays music and gains the movement-series buff: [March] , restoring 0.8% max HP every second for 20 s. With 3 movement-series buffs active, all effects from those buffs are increased by 30% .
Launches a tornado wind orb that explodes on impact and generates a forward-propelling tornado.

innate.d: Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

log: They often hover at low altitudes, paying attention to every movement on the beach and causing a ruckus.

name: Coraliz

traits.d: When entering battle, restores 500% of EP regen EP for each Earth-type Aniimo on the team. Cooldown: 15 s.

skills.d: Deals damage to the target and applies [Coral Mark] for 6 s. When [Coral Mark] ends, the marked target takes additional damage equal to 3 Might for each instance of Earth damage taken while the mark was active, and the user restores 1 EP.
Creates a coral trap ahead for 5 s. It deals damage to targets every second and applies 1 stack of Earth Debuff.
Creates quicksand ahead, dealing damage to targets and applying [Imprisonment] for 2 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Deals wide-area damage to targets in front and restores 30 EP. Hit targets enter [Imprisonment] for 2 s. When [Imprisonment] ends, the target takes additional damage equal to 25% of the original skill's Might.
Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

log: They love to bury themselves in sand, mimicking coral clumps. They use the glow of the coral on their head and back to lure creatures for a surprise attack.

name: Cornet

traits.d: Reduces the EP cost of all skills by 18%.
Increases Crit Rate by 20% while flying.

skills.d: Releases an air vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.

Fires multiple Screech Rounds at nearby targets. If multiple projectiles hit the same unit, Cornet's damage increases by 30% for 15 s. Hold the Skill button to automatically enter the Fly state after the skill is cast.
Goes all out, rapidly firing a continuous barrage of Wind Bombs.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Fires a powerful wind-type beam at the target. If you have all three Movements equipped, the attack's area of effect expands.
Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Goes all out, rapidly firing a continuous barrage of Wind Bombs. Each different Symphony buff active reduces EP cost by 8% .

log: They can produce loud, piercing noises that resonate throughout the entire beach just to draw attention.

name: Cozite

traits.d: When a skill or an Ultimate hits a target, reduces the target's Earth Resistance by -3% of ATK for 20 s. Stacks up to 10 times.

skills.d: Kicks a mud ball forward, causing it to roll and deal AoE damage on impact. Hold to aim and lob it.
Deploys a smokescreen that obscures vision. Targets cannot be aimed at through the smoke.

innate.d: Wields the power of earth to attack targets from a distance.

log: Cozites build their shells bit by bit with mud. When in danger, they spray smoke from the top hole to cover the surroundings and hide themselves.

name: Cubbo

traits.d: Builds [Rage] during battle. Basic attacks grant 2 points, every 10 EP spent on skills grants 10 , and taking damage grants 2 . At 100 points, enters the [Enraged] state. [Enraged] increases own skill damage by 30% , increases the EP recovery rate by 25% , and prevents [Rage] gain. Lasts 20s.

skills.d: Claws the target up to 3 times. When the third hit lands, the next skill gains double [Rage] . In the [Enraged] state, each hit applies 2 stacks of [Claw Mark] , up to 6 stacks.

Stomps the ground to shockwave-strike targets in front, dealing damage and clearing all Claw Mark effects on the target. Each stack of Claw Mark deals additional damage equal to 10% Might and inflicts 2 s of stun.

innate.d: Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

log: They spend their days sleepwalking. The moment they are awakened, they become agitated and lose control. Once they run out of energy, they peacefully drift back to sleep like a baby.

name: Dazmand

traits.d: The first skill this Aniimo uses within 5 s of entering battle does not consume EP. Cooldown: 15 s.

skills.d: Performs a rapid spinning kick, dealing area damage and pulling nearby targets in front of the user. Increases the entire team's CRIT Rate for Lightning damage by 25% of ATK for 20 s.

Curls into a ball and dashes at the target, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of Lightning Debuff . If the target has more than 5 stacks of Lightning Debuff after being hit, applies [Paralysis] for 5 s.
Attacks the targets while break dancing.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Spins upside down on its head at high speed, creating a massive lightning storm. During the skill, deals 12 hits of damage to targets in range, and each hit applies 1 stack of [Lightning Debuff] . The user can move while casting.
Wields the power of lightning to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Quickly sweeps with Thomas Roundhouse Kick, dealing area damage and pulling nearby targets towards you. This kick has a 50% larger range. Meanwhile, increases the entire team's Lightning DMG CRIT Rate by 25% of ATK for 20 s.

log: They have flexible limbs and love to show off their flashy kicks to anyone watching. They wear their shed skin over their heads like a cool hood.

name: Dewy

traits.d: When a skill deals damage to a target, reduces the target's Dark Resistance by 25% for 20s.
When deals damage to a target, reduces the target's Dark Resistance by -15% of ATK for 20 s.

skills.d: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing a scent to encircle itself before dive-pecking the targets to deal damage. A successful dodge will generate a shield equal to 10% of max HP for 20 s.
Releases a fragrance, dealing damage to targets within range and restoring HP to all team members equal to 5% of its own max HP. If there is only one target in range, the healing amount is doubled.

innate.d: Wields dark power to attack targets at close range.

log: As partners to perfumers, they store and ferment nectar within their bodies, transforming it into perfume ingredients.

name: Dreaple

traits.d: Every 10 s, the next skill applies 1 stack of [Drowsiness] to the target. At 3 stacks, the target enters [Nightmare] for 20 s. Targets in [Nightmare] have their Dark Resistance reduced by -35% of ATK and cannot move or cast skills for 3 s. Taking damage removes the control effect.

skills.d: Restores 5% HP to this Aniimo and nearby allies, then absorbs [Nightmare] from nearby targets. Each absorbed [Nightmare] status increases healing by 2% , up to 3 stacks.
Fires a Hypnotic Cloud Shot at the target. After it explodes, it deals damage to targets in the area and applies 1 stack of Drowsiness .
Summons a Nimbi that follows the caster, damaging targets in its path and applying 1 stack of [Drowsiness] . When hitting the caster, the Nimbi charges back toward the target.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Deals damage to targets in range and applies 2 stacks of [Drowsiness] . Increases the whole team's Dark damage by 25% of ATK for 30 s.
Wields dark power to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Summons a Nimbi that follows the caster, damaging targets in its path and applying 1 stack of [Drowsiness] . When hitting the caster, the Nimbi follows the target.

log: Their fur that has absorbed dream energy presents a mesmerizing illusion of colors. When the fur is used as a pillow, Pathfinders sink into sweet dreams.

name: Eklue

traits.d: When applies a debuff to a target, Wind damage for the whole team increases by 20% of ATK for 20 s.

skills.d: Performs an arc-shaped sweep. Enemies hit while affected by [Weakness Mark] are also [stunned] for 2.5 s.

Uses its tail amplifier to continuously emit sonar, detecting the weak points of targets within range. Keeping the target's Weakness at the center for 0.8 s applies Weakness Mark to it, reducing its CRIT resistance by -15% of ATK for 20 s.
Quickly charges toward the target, performs a backflip kick to deal damage, then jumps back to the initial position, reducing the Movement Speed of the target hit by 30% for 10 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Applies Weakness Mark to all targets within view range for 30 s. Also reduces targets' Wind Resistance by -25% of ATK for 30 s.
Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Uses its tail amplifier to continuously emit sonar, detecting the weak points of targets within range. Keeping the target's Weakness at the center for 0.4 s applies Weakness Mark to it, reducing its CRIT resistance by -15% of ATK and its damage dealt by 5% for 20 s.

log: Curious and eager to search for traces and track targets. The ring on their tail amplifies ultrasound, allowing them to easily detect cloaked creatures.

name: Eko

traits.d: When applies a debuff to a target, Wind damage for the whole team increases by 20% of ATK for 20 s.

skills.d: Performs an arc-shaped sweep. Enemies hit while affected by [Weakness Mark] are also [stunned] for 2.5 s.
Fires a Sonar Attack in a cone, dealing damage 10 times to targets within range. The final hit applies Weakness Mark , reducing the Crit Resistance Rate of targets hit by -15% of ATK for 5 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

log: With their big ears perked up, they are extremely sensitive to sound. They won't miss any movement that catches their attention, near or far.

name: Emberpup

traits.d: Increases damage dealt to elementally countered targets by 25% .
When entering combat, Damage is increased by 15% Over Time 10 seconds. Can be triggered again after not entering combat for 10 seconds.

skills.d: Launches a fireball at the target and applies 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff] for 5 s. Hold the skill button to aim.

Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing flames to swirl around it before diving down and dealing damage to targets around the landing point. A successful dodge also deals 120% damage and increases damage by 20% for 20 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of fire to attack targets at close range.

log: Lively and energetic, the creatures like to follow Flameruffs around. Once their fluffy charcoal-like fur starts to burn, they grow.

name: Erlath

traits.d: Every 12 s, enters Bathing. The next skill cast creates a puddle.

skills.d: Shoots a bubble in the target direction, knocking targets back and dealing damage, while leaving a bubble behind that lasts 9 s. This skill can be cast consecutively, storing up to 3 charges.
Casts a giant bubble, reducing the movement speed of targets within range by 15% and their EP recovery rate by 20% . Also increases the movement speed of allies within range by 15% .

Creates a bubble field. Each time a teammate casts a Water skill inside the field, 1 bubble is generated, up to 6 bubbles. Lasts 15 s. Press the skill button again to detonate all bubbles. Each bubble restores 500% of EP regen EP. After absorbing a puddle, restores an additional 10 EP.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Quickly creates 6 bubbles and increases teammates' Water damage by 20% of ATK for 30 s.
Wields the power of water to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Activating the skill immediately spawns 2 bubbles and creates a bubble field. While allies are inside the field, each time they use a Water-element skill, 1 bubble is generated, up to a maximum of 6 , lasting 15 s. Pressing the skill key again detonates all bubbles, restoring 500% of EP regen energy per bubble. After absorbing a puddle, you also gain an additional 10 energy.

log: Their feathers constantly secrete oil, which produces all kinds of bubbles with just a little rubbing. Naturally, they use the softest, fluffiest foam to protect the Fahloos on their backs.

name: Fahloo

traits.d: Every 12 s, enters Bathing. The next skill cast creates a puddle.

skills.d: Shoots a bubble in the target direction, knocking targets back and dealing damage, while leaving a bubble behind that lasts 9 s. This skill can be cast consecutively, storing up to 3 charges.

Releases a giant bubble, reducing the movement speed of targets within range by 15% and their EP recovery rate by 20% . Also increases the movement speed of allies within range by 15% . Lasts for 15 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of water to attack targets from a distance.

log: They rub the oils on their bodies to create lots of foam that cleans and protects them, though they sometimes step on it and slip.

name: Fenmane

traits.d: When this Aniimo's attack hits a target, it gains 1 stack of [Thunderbond] . At 30 stacks, it enters the [Thunderwing Stance] when using its next skill or Ultimate. Lasts 10 s.

skills.d: Gains [Thunder Imprint] . While active, each hit against a target stores the damage dealt on the target. When the effect ends, all stored damage is dealt at once. Recasting the skill during this period triggers the stored damage early. Lasts 8 s. If the target has 10 stacks of [Lightning Debuff] , consumes them to deal an additional 100% damage.

Generates a thunder field that follows the target. When a target within the thunder field is hit by a Lightning attack, it is hit by an additional Lightning attack and inflicted with Lightning Debuff . Lightning attacks can trigger this effect no more than once every 0.2 s. The thunder field lasts for 8 s.
Launches a lightning dart at the target, dealing damage to all targets along the way while drawing them closer over time.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Transforms the lightning wrapped around both wings into 5 arrows and fires them at the target. If in Thunderwing Stance , fires 5 additional arrows and finally deals explosion damage equal to 20 Might.
Wields the power of lightning to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Release a Thunder Field centered on the target that continuously follows it. While the target is inside the Thunder Field, getting hit by a Lightning ATK will trigger an additional Lightning ATK and inflict Lightning Debuff on the target. The Thunder Field lasts 8 s. Lightning ATK triggered by the Thunder Field grants 2 stacks of Thunderbond .

log: With their highly conductive fur, they harness the power of lightning to extend their wings and dash forth, dispelling the haze and lifting their spirits.

name: Fennelun

traits.d: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 30% . Casting a skill or Ultimate grants 4 stacks of [Silver Moon Mark] . Each basic attack hit consumes 1 stack, deals 100% extra damage, and restores 0.5% HP.

skills.d: Drops a full moon onto the target, triggering an explosion and dealing damage. If it hits a target with [Fox Mark] , deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 10% .

Pulls the target while gathering a full moon above, then throws it at the target to trigger an explosion and deal damage. If it hits a target with [Fox Mark] , deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 20% .
Fires 3 Light missiles at targets, prioritizing different targets. Applies [Fox Mark] to targets hit, reducing their Light Resistance by 5% . Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 s.
Pours the power of moonlight onto the target, dealing massive additional BREAK damage based on the Aniimo's level.
Bathes in moonlight and recovers 20 EP.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Unleashes Selene's Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage, evolves into Fennelun , and increases its Damage Amp by 15% until combat ends. Also gains 4 stacks of Silvermoon Mark .
Wields the power of light to attack targets from a distance.

log: The soft moonlight running through their fur gives them an aloof and rational look. But they can also be sentimental.

name: Fenrier

traits.d: When dealing damage to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] , increases Crit Rate of that damage by 15% .
Increases ATK by 12% for 15s when entering battle.
CRIT Damage increased by 40%.

skills.d: Lunges forward and spins to create a magic field that fires 3 ice blades for 3 hits, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] .

Throws an ice blade forward, dealing damage to targets in range and applying stacks of [Ice Debuff] . The ice blade continuously consumes energy while spinning, and pressing the Skill button again recalls it.

innate.d: Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

log: Resisting gentle pets that might soften its resolve, it leads family hunts with its ice blade.

name: Fentuft

traits.d: When this Aniimo's attack hits a target, it gains 1 stack of [Thunderbond] . At 30 stacks, it enters the [Thunderwing Stance] when using its next skill or Ultimate. Lasts 10 s.

skills.d: Generates a thunder field that follows the target. When a target within the thunder field is hit by a Lightning attack, it is hit by an additional Lightning attack and inflicted with Lightning Debuff . Lightning attacks can trigger this effect no more than once every 0.2 s. The thunder field lasts for 8 s.
Launches a lightning dart at the target, dealing damage to all targets along the way while drawing them closer over time.

innate.d: Wields the power of lightning to attack targets from a distance.

log: They always wear their signature smiles and invite other Aniimo to play. Their mischief and greed may get them into trouble now and then, but they're always forgiven.

name: Flamerion

traits.d: When a skill hits a target, inflicts Scorched on them, reducing their Fire Resistance by 2%. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 25s.
Always has 20 stacks of [Fire Debuff] . [Trick Fire Ring] applies 4 stacks of [Fire Debuff] , while [Fire Orb] applies 3 stacks of [Fire Debuff] .

skills.d: Throws an explosive fireball at the target. Press and hold to aim.
Launches a fire ring that expands then contracts to attack the target. The farther the target is, the more damage it will take, up to 50% increased damage.
Slams all targets within range that are affected by [Fire Debuff] from a distance. Restores 400% of EP regen EP for each stack of [Fire Debuff] on the target, up to 3600% of EP regen EP.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Jumps up and throws a giant fireball at the target. It explodes on landing, dealing wide-area damage and applying 12 stacks of [Fire Debuff] .
Wields the power of fire to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Slam the target, immediately restoring 5 Energy. Perform a remote slam on all other targets within range affected by [Fire Debuff] . For each stack of [Fire Debuff] on a target, restore 400% of EP regen Energy, up to 3600% of EP regen points.

log: They only come out at night. Since their bodies are made of gaseous energy, they can split at will and even create clones.

name: Flameruff

traits.d: Increases damage dealt to elementally countered targets by 25% .
When entering combat, Damage is increased by 15% Over Time 10 seconds. Can be triggered again after not entering combat for 10 seconds.

skills.d: Launches a fireball at the target and applies 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff] for 5 s. Hold the skill button to aim.

Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing flames to swirl around it before diving down and dealing damage to targets around the landing point. A successful dodge also deals 120% damage and increases damage by 20% for 20 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of fire to attack targets at close range.

log: Pack creatures that prize loyalty and unity, these hunters have calm, focused eyes that conceal their fiery hearts.

name: Flutternym

traits.d: When entering battle as the active Aniimo, increases healing by 20% . If off field, appears as a phantom. When other Aniimo cast skills or Ultimates, restores HP equal to 0.5% of max HP.
Increases healing by 10%.

skills.d: Creates a warm wind area beneath the feet, continuously healing the entire team for 9% of the caster's Max HP over 8 s. Wind-type Aniimo receive an additional 3% healing.
Removes all debuffs on surrounding teammates. Once the debuffs are removed, increases their EP recovery rate by 20% for 10 s.

innate.d: Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

log: They are timid and hide whenever they sense danger, but the fluorescent scales they shake off always give them away.

name: Fragrancier

traits.d: When a skill deals damage to a target, reduces the target's Dark Resistance by 25% for 20s.
When deals damage to a target, reduces the target's Dark Resistance by -15% of ATK for 20 s.

skills.d: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing a scent to encircle itself before dive-pecking the targets to deal damage. A successful dodge will generate a shield equal to 10% of max HP for 20 s.
Releases a fragrance, dealing damage to targets within range and restoring HP to all team members equal to 5% of its own max HP. If there is only one target in range, the healing amount is doubled.
Deals damage to targets in front and applies Secret Fragrance for 20 s. While the marks are active, Dark-type basic attacks deal 50% extra damage to the targets.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Flaps its wings to release a fragrance, increasing Dark Elemental Boost for all team members by 25% of ATK for 30 s. Also [charms] targets within range, leaving them dizzy for a short duration.
Wields dark power to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Deals damage to targets in front and applies [Secret Fragrance] for 20 s. While the mark is active, Dark basic attacks deal 60% bonus damage to the target and have a 25% chance to deal an additional hit equal to the Might of Fragrancier's basic attack. Trigger interval: 0.5 s.

log: They're picky about odors, so they harvest and store various nectar within them to craft unique perfume ingredients.

name: Fulmintis

traits.d: Restores 4 EP when a skill lands a critical hit.

skills.d: Enhances the blade, increasing skill Crit Rate by 35% for 20 s.

After dashing to close in on the target, it continuously consumes Energy to perform consecutive slashes. When Energy is depleted or clicked again, it unleashes a Spinning Slash that deals 26 Might damage. For every 3 consecutive slashes accumulated by this skill, the final Spinning Slash deals 100% increased damage.
Hold to enter Aim Mode and fire two Electric Blade Shock Waves. Critical hits inflict [Paralysis] on the target for 6 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Deals multiple hits to targets in a straight line. Targets hit will be [paralyzed] for 3 s.
(BREAK) Wields the power of lightning to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: After dashing to the target, it continuously consumes Energy to perform consecutive slashes, increasing slash frequency by 20% . When Energy is depleted or tapped again, unleashes a Spinning Slash that deals 26 Might damage. For every 3 consecutive slashes accumulated by the skill, the final Spinning Slash deals 100% increased damage.

log: Evolved from a Wisptis with broken forelimbs absorbing the power of lightning. The reshaped reverse blades are incredibly sharp and flash with dazzling electric light.

name: Gachapus

traits.d: Each basic attack and skill triggers the gacha once, randomly firing an orange, purple, blue, or gold bubble and adding that bubble color to the gacha slots. Gold bubbles have a 1% chance to appear, while each other color has a 33% chance to appear. When the slots hold 5 bubbles of the same color, or when a gold bubble appears, all bubbles are cleared and [Jackpot] begins for 10 s. In [Jackpot] , basic attacks and skills no longer trigger the gacha and always fire Rainbow Bubbles. Basic attack damage + 60% .

skills.d: Consumes the least common bubble color. The next basic attack is guaranteed to fire the most common color, and basic attack damage increases by 25% for 15 s.
Continuously spits bubbles at the target for 5 s. The user can move while casting, but movement speed is reduced. This skill's damage counts as basic attack damage.

Spits enhanced bubbles at the target. Effects vary by bubble color: orange bubbles deal AoE damage, blue bubbles restore 5 EP on hit, purple bubbles deal 20% additional damage, and gold and rainbow bubbles combine all three effects.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Spits a giant rainbow bubble at the target, dealing damage over a large area and immediately entering the [Jackpot] status for 10 s.
Wields the power of water to attack targets from a distance.

log: With a quick tap from its nimble tentacles, it can launch all kinds of capsule bubbles from its head. No one knows what will pop out next—a delightful surprise, or a complete accident.

name: Geoclaw

traits.d: Basic attacks apply [Ice Debuff] . Deals 35% extra BREAK to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] .
While in Tunnel state, restore 2 Energy when dealing Damage to targets. Can be triggered once per second at most.
Restores 2 Energy when dealing Skill Damage to a target. Can be triggered once per second at most.

skills.d: Summons an Ice Storm that continuously builds up [Ice Debuff] on targets. The Ice Storm keeps moving forward until it hits a wall or a target.
Creates an ice spike ahead, attacking and [freezing] the target for 2.5 s. Can be used during tunneling. Afterward, dashes forward and emerges from underground.
Gathers icy vapor in both pincers, then slams them down to deal AoE damage in front and create an ice wall for 5 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Deals damage over a large area.
(BREAK) Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Summons an Ice Storm that continuously builds up [Ice Debuff] on targets. The Ice Storm keeps moving forward until it hits a wall or a target. It also increases debuff buildup efficiency by 30% and expands the area by 30% .

log: They live in caves, feed on minerals, and use their beautifully crystallized shells to lure prey.

name: Geodeback

traits.d: While in [Tunneling] state, can cast skills and deal 20% extra BREAK damage.

Gains 1 stack of Momentum every 5s while tunneling, up to 5 stacks. Also gains 1 stack of Momentum each time damage is negated. When tunneling ends, each stack of Momentum converts into a shield equal to 6% HP for 20s.

skills.d: Fires a stone shell at the target.
Generates a line of stone spikes that extend forward, piercing all targets in their path.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

log: The minerals they eat are refined within their bodies and transformed into crystal spines infused with pure energy.

name: Glacy

traits.d: Increases healing by 10%.
While in water terrain, reduces the EP cost of all skills by 20% of EP regen.

skills.d: Restores all allies' HP by an amount equal to 8% of the caster's max HP, and restores HP to the caster equal to 10% of their max HP over 5 s.
Shoots Water Orbs to attack a target. Press and hold the skill button to aim.
Spits bubbles to attack a target. Press and hold the skill button to keep spitting, continuously consuming EP and dealing damage to all targets hit.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Creates a circular water zone at a fixed location. While within the area, allies are healed for 36% of the caster's Max HP over 6 s.
Wields the power of water to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Restores HP to all allies equal to 8% of the caster's max HP, and restores HP to the caster equal to 12% of their max HP over 2.5 s.

log: They are elegant and kind Aniimo that always take care of weaker ones, and freeze anyone who crosses them in ice.

name: Glameep

traits.d: Automatically restores 1 points of [Bubble Energy] per second. Each time your own skill deals damage to a target, you also recover an additional 3 points, up to a maximum of 10 points stored. When you cast [Baa Baa Healing], it consumes 10 points and grants an extra 12% .

skills.d: Fires a bubble beam that pierces through allies and opponents, dealing damage to targets and applying a shield to allies along its path. The shield equals 7.0% of the caster's Max HP and lasts 10 s.
While floating and moving, heals all allies within range for 12% of the caster's Max HP over 6 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Increases healing received by all nearby allies by 15% for 30 s, and restores the caster's HP equal to 21% of their Max HP over 2 s.
Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

log: Draped in fresh green leaf-feathers, Glameep moves lightly along the lake shore. It adores clear water most of all, especially when that water reflects its own graceful, unhurried beauty.

name: Glynsera

traits.d: When dealing damage to targets with more than 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] , increases Crit Rate of that damage by 15% .
Increases ATK by 12% for 15s when entering battle.
CRIT Damage increased by 40%.

skills.d: Lunges forward and spins to create a magic field that fires 3 ice blades for 3 hits, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] .
Flips forward toward the target and slams the ground with a tail strike, dealing damage. Can consume 10 stacks of [Ice Debuff] to deal 85% extra damage.

Throws an ice blade forward, dealing damage to targets in range and applying stacks of [Ice Debuff] . The ice blade continuously consumes energy while spinning, and pressing the Skill button again recalls it.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Turns into an icy tornado to continuously attack its targets.
Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Flips forward toward the target and slams the ground with its tail, dealing damage. Can consume 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff] to deal an additional 85% damage.

log: Proud and confident warriors, they send shivers down their enemies' spines with the chilling blades in their mouths.

name: Gracewing

traits.d: When entering battle as the active Aniimo, increases healing by 20% . If off field, appears as a phantom. When other Aniimo cast skills or Ultimates, restores HP equal to 0.5% of max HP.
Increases healing by 10%.

skills.d: Creates a warm wind area beneath the feet, continuously healing the entire team for 9% of the caster's Max HP over 8 s. Wind-type Aniimo receive an additional 3% healing.
Removes all debuffs on surrounding teammates. Once the debuffs are removed, increases their EP recovery rate by 20% for 10 s.
Creates a Phantomfly at the location, restoring 20 EP to all teammates that touch it after a 3 s delay. There can be up to 2 Phantomflies at the same time.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Instantly heals the whole team for 30% of the caster's max HP.
Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Creates a warm wind area beneath the feet, continuously healing the entire team for 9% of the caster's Max HP. over 8 s. Wind-type Aniimo receive an additional 6% healing.

log: Lone wanderers. They create illusions by shedding scales from their wings when threats approach.

name: Grizbo

traits.d: Builds [Rage] during battle. Basic attacks grant 2 points, every 10 EP spent on skills grants 10 , and taking damage grants 2 . At 100 points, enters the [Enraged] state. [Enraged] increases own skill damage by 30% , increases the EP recovery rate by 25% , and prevents [Rage] gain. Lasts 20s.

skills.d: Claws the target up to 3 times. When the third hit lands, the next skill gains double [Rage] . In the [Enraged] state, each hit applies 2 stacks of [Claw Mark] , up to 6 stacks.

Stomps the ground to shockwave-strike targets in front, dealing damage and clearing all Claw Mark effects on the target. Each stack of Claw Mark deals additional damage equal to 10% Might and inflicts 2 s of stun.
Strikes hard to deal high damage and remove all [Claw Mark] effects from the target. Each stack of [Claw Mark] deals additional damage equal to 10% of Might.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Leaps high, immediately gains 100 [Rage] , and becomes [Enraged] , then crashes down with thunderous force, dealing delayed burst damage to targets around the impact point.
Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Strikes hard to deal high damage and remove all [Claw Mark] effects from the target. Each stack of [Claw Mark] deals additional damage equal to 10% of Might. After damage is resolved, retains 50% of the [Claw Mark] stacks.

log: Beneath their gentle exterior lies constant restraint and suppressed aggression. However, when provoked or hungry, they lose control and fall into a frenzy.

name: Helgon

traits.d: Increases damage dealt to Stunned targets by 20%.
After being attacked, increases BREAK efficiency by 25% for 10 s.

skills.d: Tackles and pushes small-sized targets. Increases own damage reduction by 15% for 10 s.
Claws a target, dealing damage.

Enters a defensive stance, increasing Damage Reduction by 30% and immediately counterattacking when hit. If attacked at the moment the skill is cast, additionally increases BREAK Efficiency by 20% for 10 s and [stuns] the target for 1.5 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Flies up and dives down to hit the ground, dealing huge amount of damage.
(BREAK) Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Enters a defensive stance, increasing Damage Reduction by 30% and immediately counterattacking when hit. While the effect is active, other skills can be used and movement is allowed. If attacked at the moment the skill is cast, additionally increases BREAK Efficiency by 20% for 10 s and [stuns] the target for 1.5 s.

log: Covered in hard armor, they look like tall statues when they stand still, as if standing guard over ancient treasures.

name: Helion

traits.d: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 30% . Every 4 basic attacks grants [Solar Halo] , enhancing the next skill.

skills.d: Dives from the air at the target, causing a Holy Light explosion upon landing. If you have Ring of the Golden Sun , this damage is increased by 30% .

Unleashes a lion's roar imbued with holy power to attack targets. On hit, increases the user's Light Damage Amp by 6% , stacking up to 3 times for 20 s. [Solar Halo] enhances this skill's effect, applying 3 stacks each time.

Spins and leaps into the air, whipping up a storm that pulls targets toward its center while dealing high BREAK damage based on the Aniimo's level. [Solar Halo] enhances the skill effect, with the final hit dealing an additional 1 s stun.
Bathes in sunlight and restores 20 EP. [Solar Halo] enhances the skill, restoring an extra 5 EP.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Unleashes Helios' Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage. Evolves into Soleon , increases its own Damage Amp by 15% until leaving combat, and gains Ring of the Golden Sun .
Wields the power of light to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Dives from the air at the target, causing a Holy Light explosion upon landing. If this Aniimo has [Solar Halo] , this hit deals 30% more damage and restores 4% HP. There is also a 75% chance this skill will not consume [Solar Halo] .

log: Enthusiastic and confident, they always stand up for their friends at critical moments, displaying amazing power.

name: Helmut

traits.d: Increases BREAK by 10000% of DEF .

skills.d: Jumps up and smashes down on the target to deal damage. Up to three consecutive smashes are allowed, and the third smash will stun the target for 1 s.

Enters the [Ballistic Guard] state, increasing the user's damage reduction by 20% and greatly boosting interruption resistance. When attacked, releases a shock wave around the user that deals damage equal to 10 Might. This can trigger no more than once every 0.2 s.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of darkness to attack targets at close range.

log: That tough helmet keeps its squishy body safe, while those extendable mouth-claws help it hunt.

name: Helmwhelp

traits.d: Increases damage dealt to Stunned targets by 20%.
After being attacked, increases BREAK efficiency by 25% for 10 s.

skills.d: Tackles and pushes small-sized targets. Increases own damage reduction by 15% for 10 s.
Claws a target, dealing damage.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

log: A fledgling dragon that hides its weakness beneath its helmet, yearning to grow stronger so it can soar freely to every corner of the world in search of hidden treasures.

name: Hexxin

traits.d: Every 18 s, the next skill applies [Curse] to enemies hit for 10 s. Dark basic attacks restore 50% of EP regen EP when hitting enemies with [Curse] .

skills.d: Lets out a special scream, piercing all enemies ahead and restoring 10 Energy.
Quickly backsteps a short distance, leaving a black hole beneath the target that continuously pulls the target in and deals damage.
Releases an energy shock wave around the target, dealing damage to enemies hit and reducing their healing received by -56.0% of max HP for 20 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Gathers annihilation energy in the palm and hurls it toward the target, dealing massive AoE damage.
Wields dark power to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Lets out a special scream, piercing all enemies ahead and restoring 15 Energy.

log: They make bizarre noises to drive intruders to madness, lower their defenses and even cause them to pass out.

name: Hummin

traits.d: For every 1,000 max HP, increases BREAK damage by 2% .
Every 18 s, the next skill applies [Curse] to enemies hit for 10 s. Dark basic attacks restore 50% of EP regen EP when hitting enemies with [Curse] .

skills.d: Rams into the target with the body.
Lets out a special scream, dealing damage to enemies in a frontal cone and restoring 10 energy.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of grass to attack targets at close range.

log: They live on the grassland in groups, they like burrowing for nutrients, and they love singing off-key together!

name: Ignitis

traits.d: When attacking targets not in combat, increases BREAK damage dealt by 50% for 15s.
Defeating a target grants 1 stack of Battlelust , increasing damage by 25% for 20 s. Stacks up to 2 times.

skills.d: Tackles the target with the power of shadows, increasing basic attack damage by 40% for 10 s after casting.
Spins to slash, dealing Dark damage 4 times to all nearby targets. Each hit increases own damage by 4% , up to 32% , for 10 s.

Transports itself to a target and attacks. If the target has less than 50% HP left, for each 1% HP lost, increases the Aniimo's damage by 1% . Defeating a target with this skill grants a time-limited free recast.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Cleaves through space, dealing heavy Physical damage.
Wields dark power to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Teleports to the target and launches a wide-area assault. When the target's HP is below 70% , damage increases by 1% for every 1% HP the target has lost. If this skill defeats the target, it can be recast for a short time without consuming EP.

log: They sharpen their blades and wait for the perfect moment, hiding in the shadows as they toy with their prey. As cold-blooded assassins, they seek to end every fight in a single strike.

name: Infergon

traits.d: Deals 30% extra damage to targets with more than 5 stacks of Fire Debuff .

skills.d: Casts Flaming Claws at the target. A powerful claw strike can be cast again within 5 s. Both 2 claw strikes can consume 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff] from the target to deal additional damage equal to 30 Might.
Charges at the target to deal damage. If used while flying, dives at the target and stops flying. On hit, gains a shield equal to 5% of max HP for 10 s.
Breathes fire forward, attacking targets and applying 8 stacks of [Fire Debuff] .

innate.d: (Ultimate) Breathes powerful Lava Breath from the air, dealing damage to all targets within a large area in front and applying 8 stacks of [Fire Debuff] .
Wields the power of fire to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Sweeps its breath forward, attacking targets and applying 12 stacks of Fire Debuff .

log: Clad in heavy metal armor forged in searing flames, it can unleash a fury of fire that turns everything around it into molten lava. If you don't want to be reduced to ash, stay as far away from it as possible.

name: Inferlupa

traits.d: After using 8 basic attacks in battle, Inferlupa enters Full Energy, enhancing its next skill. Damage dealt by that skill is treated as basic attack damage.

skills.d: Fires a Flameruff Spirit that ricochets between targets, increasing BREAK efficiency against them by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 20 s. Ricochets 5 times by default. While in the [Full Energy] state, ricochets 7 times.
Summons 2 clones to attack the selected location. Summons 1 extra clone while in the [Full Energy] state.
Fires a flame ray that penetrates targets and deals up to 9 hits of damage. While [Full Energy] is active, Might increases by 45% .

innate.d: (Ultimate) Summons a soul clone to perform a forward Tackle. Upon hitting a target, it explodes, dealing damage.
(BREAK) Wields the power of darkness to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Fires a Flameruff Spirit that ricochets between targets, prioritizing the locked-on target at the time of launch. Increases BREAK efficiency for targets hit by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks, lasting 20 s. Base ricochets: 6 times. Ricochets 8 times while in Full Energy state.

log: A Flameruff who challenged the strong and lost. Having absorbed the souls of companions who fell with equal bitterness, it is driven by the desire for revenge.

name: Iris

traits.d: While on Turf, Damage Amp increases by 30% . After entering battle, each skill hit grants 1 [Dance Power] . Hitting multiple targets does not grant extra [Dance Power]. At 24 , the next skill costs no EP.
While on Turf, gains 1 point of Dance Power each time a skill deals damage. At 24 points, the next skill will cost zero EP and grant a 50% damage increase for 2s.

skills.d: Spins while moving and releases magical petals that track targets. The number of petals released increases by 1 over time, up to 3 at once. Press the skill again to stop casting.
Generates a large vortex of petals at the feet of the target to attack it.

innate.d: Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

log: Iris possesses an extremely lightweight body, often lifted by the wind. It then either slowly spirals downward using the resistance from its petal skirt, or simply allows itself to be carried away by the wind.

name: Irisal

traits.d: While on Turf, Damage Amp increases by 30% . After entering battle, each skill hit grants 1 [Dance Power] . Hitting multiple targets does not grant extra [Dance Power]. At 24 , the next skill costs no EP.
While on Turf, gains 1 point of Dance Power each time a skill deals damage. At 24 points, the next skill will cost zero EP and grant a 50% damage increase for 2s.

skills.d: Generates a large vortex of petals at the feet of the target to attack it.
Spins while moving and releases magical petals that track targets. The number of petals released increases by 1 over time, up to 3 at once. Press the skill again to stop casting.
Fires an energy beam at targets ahead. After gaining 24 points of [Dance Power] , the next skill cast has a larger range.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Spins and releases a storm of petals to attack a target.
Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Fires an energy beam at targets ahead. After gaining 24 points of [Dance Power] , the next skill cast has a larger range. After casting, immediately gain an additional 5 stacks of Dance Power .

log: Devoted to the art of dance, they constantly hone their craft, hoping to share the pure joy and energy of movement.

name: Irisalis

traits.d: When casting Whirling Blossom Rain or landing the final hit of a basic attack, all Irisalis clones fire floral beams at the target, each with 15 Might. If an Irisalis clone's attack hits, this Aniimo gains 1 Dance Power. After accumulating 9 Dance Power, the next skill cast costs 50% less EP. When Fainted, it turns back into a flower and blooms again, restoring vitality. Can trigger once every 180 s.

skills.d: Spins and dashes in the chosen direction, firing multiple homing bolts in succession. Also activates all Iris clones to fire floral light beams.
After Iris Shot hits a target, summons 1 Iris Clone for 30 s. The clone immediately fires a Floral Gleam Beam at the target. Casting the skill again resets the clones.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Condenses energy into a massive phantom that dives down and slams into the ground, dealing area damage and leaving 1 Irisalis clone that lasts 30 s. This clone can coexist with the clone summoned by Irisalis Shadow . Recasting the Ultimate resets the clone.
Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: After Iris Shot hits a target, summons 1 Iris Clone. The clone immediately fires a Floral Gleam Beam at the target and summons 1 additional clone. All clones last 30 s. Casting the skill again resets the clones.

log: They absorb the world's colors as floral raiment, bringing colorful vitality to nature. If petals wither, they can bloom again by returning to the earth's embrace.

name: Jawling

traits.d: Increases damage dealt to Stunned targets by 20%.
After being attacked, increases BREAK efficiency by 25% for 10 s.

skills.d: Claws a target, dealing damage.
Tackles and pushes small-sized targets. Increases own damage reduction by 15% for 10 s.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of wind to attack targets at close range.

log: It loves to take a bite out of anything it comes across. Its highly flexible jaw can open extremely wide. It shows affection and happiness through gentle nibbles, and especially loves biting metal objects because they are hard to damage.

name: Lavazar

traits.d: After spending a total of 50 EP, gains [Pyro Charge]. Every 2 s, applies 1 stack of [Fire Debuff] to nearby targets for 10 s.

skills.d: Sprays flames at the target in front, dealing damage over time and applying [Fire Debuff] to the target hit.
Dashes forward with a punch, dealing damage and piercing through targets. Also removes all [Fire Debuff] stacks from the target. Each stack of [Fire Debuff] deals additional damage equal to 5% Might.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of fire to attack targets at close range.

log: They use hard claws to crush crystals and eat them to store heat, causing fiery red patterns to appear on their body. Though small, they can continuously spew high-heat flame streams from their mouth.

name: Leafy

traits.d: While off field, creates a patch of Turf under a teammate after they cast 3 skills.
Increases healing by 10%.
Restores 1 Energy when attacking targets on Turf. Can be triggered once every 1 seconds at most.

skills.d: Launches a circular magic attack around the target. If affected targets are on grass, they are bound by vines and enter a [Stunned] state for 3 s.

Creates a circular magic field underfoot, restoring 300% of EP regen EP every second to Grass-type teammates within range for 12 s. The field also upgrades nearby Turf into Vitality Blooms, restoring 1% HP every second to Grass-type teammates within range.
Swipes its tail and releases a forward-moving cyclone of leaves to attack targets. Turf is formed around the Aniimo and along the cyclone's path for 20 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Quickly forms a lotus cocoon that bursts open, instantly healing the whole team for 15% of the caster's max HP, and grants the entire team 15% Grass Elemental Boost for 30 s.
Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Creates a circular magic circle underfoot, restoring 300% of EP regen Energy and 100% of EP regen Ultimate Energy per second to Grass-type teammates within range for 12 s. After leaving the area, the magic circle's effect remains for 3 s. The magic circle also upgrades grass within range into Vitality Blooms, restoring 1% HP per second to Grass-type teammates within range.

log: They live among lotus flowers and use their lotus leaf tails to conceal their face and show off their elegant nature.

name: Luminelle

traits.d: Teammates who receive this Aniimo's skill buff also gain a 15% of ATK Lightning boost for 20 s.
Increases healing by 10%.
While in battle, the next skill grants an additional 25 Ultimate Points. Can trigger once every 15s.

skills.d: Quickly retreats, leaving behind a jellyfish clone that releases a wave of Lightning energy to attack targets and slow them by 15% for 10 s.
Fires an energy beam. Hold the skill button to keep firing, damaging targets within range and healing Lightning-type teammates within range for 2% HP every second.
Channels energy to recharge allies. Lightning-type teammates' basic attack damage increases by 35% of ATK , and their BREAK efficiency increases by 20% of ATK for 20 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Continuously increases its voltage and eventually triggers an explosion, dealing wide-area damage and creating an electric field underfoot. Inside the field, Lightning Elemental Boost increases by 25% of ATK for 30 s.
Wields the power of lightning to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Channels energy to recharge allies. Lightning-type teammates' basic attack damage increases by 40% of ATK , and their BREAK efficiency increases by 25% of ATK for 20 s.

log: Changes its glow to match its mood while its tentacles create mesmerizing patterns and deliver shocking attacks.

name: Lunara

traits.d: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 30% . Casting a skill or Ultimate grants 4 stacks of [Silver Moon Mark] . Each basic attack hit consumes 1 stack, deals 100% extra damage, and restores 0.5% HP.

skills.d: Drops a full moon onto the target, triggering an explosion and dealing damage. If it hits a target with [Fox Mark] , deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 10% .
Fires 3 Light missiles at targets, prioritizing different targets. Applies [Fox Mark] to targets hit, reducing their Light Resistance by 5% . Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 s.
Pours the power of moonlight onto the target, dealing massive additional BREAK damage based on the Aniimo's level.
Bathes in moonlight and recovers 20 EP.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Unleashes Selene's Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage, evolves into Fennelun , and increases its Damage Amp by 15% until combat ends. Also gains 4 stacks of Silvermoon Mark .
Wields the power of light to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Pulls the target while gathering a full moon above, then throws it at the target to trigger an explosion and deal damage. If it hits a target with [Fox Mark] , deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 20% .

log: Their eyes shimmer with the deep blue light of the moon, and mysterious patterns appear when they wield their power.

name: Magmarex

traits.d: After spending a total of 50 EP, gains [Pyro Charge]. Every 2 s, applies 1 stack of [Fire Debuff] to nearby targets for 10 s.

skills.d: Sprays flames at the target in front, dealing damage over time and applying [Fire Debuff] to the target hit.

name: Susuta

traits.d: When entering battle, if the party has an opposite-sex Susuta family member, increases own BREAK efficiency by 30% for 15 s. Cooldown: 20 s.
Upon entering battle, if the target is the opposite sex, its fur turns pink, increasing damage dealt by 10% and reducing damage taken by 10% for 20s. Triggers once every 20s.
When in water, EP recovery rate increases by 0% for 15s.

skills.d: Dashes at the target, dealing damage and knocking them back.
Jumps up and hurls a huge water ball at the target, dealing AoE damage and creating a puddle.

innate.d: (BREAK) Wields the power of water to attack targets at close range.

log: They dig around to search for gifts to give to their crushes, but their wooing always fails because they are so shy.

name: Thornblade

traits.d: Increases Grass damage by 12%.
Each skill used grants 1 stack of [Sword Dance] , up to 4 stacks, lasting 15 s. Each basic attack costs 1 stack of [Sword Dance] to deal 180% extra damage.

skills.d: Enters a defensive stance, reducing damage taken by 20% . While in this state, it counters when attacked. If attacked just as the skill is used, its critical rate increases by 30% for 15 s.
Rapidly attacks the target with its thorn blade. Can be used up to 3 times in a row.
Thrusts toward the target. On hit, increases this Aniimo's Crit Rate by 15% for 15 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Repeatedly stabs a target with its thorn blade.
Wields the power of grass to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Rapidly attacks the target with its thorn blade. Can be used up to 3 times in a row. Grants 1 stack of [Sword Dance] for 15 s. The next basic attack skips directly to the third hit.

log: The swords made from thorny stems are drawn only when it's time to protect their family against enemies.

name: Tromber

traits.d: Reduces the EP cost of all skills by 18%.
When switching Aniimo in battle, restores 2500% of ATK EP to the next Chirpi family member switched in. Triggers once every 20 s at most.

skills.d: Releases an air vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.
Plays music and gains the movement-series buff: [Waltz] , increasing Crit Damage by 35% of ATK for 20 s. With 3 movement-series buffs active, all effects from those buffs are increased by 30% .

Fires a Wind Bomb at the target, dealing damage. After 1s, a second explosion erupts around the hit target, dealing additional AoE damage equal to 30% of the original Might. The second explosion reduces the Wind Resistance of hit targets by 3% , up to 5 stacks, for 20 s.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Deals Wind damage over a large area and increases all party members' Wind damage by 25% for 30 s.
Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Plays music and gains the movement-series buff [Waltz] , increasing Crit Damage by 35% of ATK for 20 s. Also gains [March] . With 3 movement-series buffs active, all effects from those buffs are increased by 30% .

log: They like having fun and producing rhythmic music, so don't be surprised to see a grand symphony.

name: Tubster

traits.d: While shielded, BREAK efficiency + 40% . When triggering BREAK, plays [Concerto] , reducing the whole team's stamina cost by 30% . When you have 3 Movement-series buffs, increases all Movement effects by 30% .
Reduces the EP cost of all skills by 18%.
When switching Aniimo in battle, restores 2500% of ATK EP to the next Chirpi family member switched in. Triggers once every 20 s at most.

skills.d: Releases an air vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.
Flaps its wings to fire 2 arcing whirlwinds, pulling targets along their paths. When the whirlwinds meet, they explode and deal AoE damage.

Assumes a defensive stance and gains 20% Damage Reduction. When the defensive stance ends, gains a shield equal to 10% max HP for 20 s. press the skill again to end it early. While in the defensive stance, each hit taken increases the shield gained by 10% , up to 100% .

innate.d: (Ultimate) Creates a field that continuously grants allies within range 35% damage reduction for 7 s.
(BREAK) Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Assumes a defensive stance and gains 20% Damage Reduction. When the defensive stance ends, gains a shield equal to 10% max HP for 20 s. press the skill again to end it early. While in the defensive stance, each hit taken increases the shield gained by 10% , up to 100% . When the shield expires, converts 30% of the remaining shield into healing.

log: Creates deep, tuba-like sounds that match its steady, friendly character.

name: Tuckin

traits.d: Increases BREAK damage by % for every 21,000 max HP. Upon entering battle, summons 1 Hummin to assist. An additional Hummin is summoned every 10 s, up to a maximum of 3 .

skills.d: Teleports all Hummins next to the target and unleashes a Tackle attack, dealing damage.
Causes all Hummins to blink next to the target and unleash sonic attacks, dealing area damage and inflicting [Stun] for 1 s.
Roots itself firmly in the soil, granting self and Hummin 20% BREAK efficiency. Instantly restores 50% HP to all Hummins, and heals self and nearby Hummins for 2% HP every second.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Restores Hummin units to their maximum number, then roars with them to release a massive shockwave at the target.
(BREAK) Wields the power of grass to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Roots itself firmly in the soil, granting self and Hummin 30% BREAK efficiency and 20% Damage Reduction. Instantly restores 50% HP to all Hummins, and heals self and nearby Hummins for 2% HP every second.

log: They need to absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots to maintain vitality and hate leaving the ground.

name: Turbo

traits.d: Increases damage dealt by 15% while a shield is active.
Gains 1 stack after being off the field for 5 s or casting a basic attack. At 4 stacks, enters [Shrouded in Mist] state. Casting a skill consumes this state to enhance the skill's effects.

skills.d: Throws a missile condensed from clouds at the target. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist] , the missile creates a larger explosion on hit, dealing damage equal to 180% Might.

Creates a cloud shield to protect itself, absorbing damage up to 15% max HP and reducing stamina consumption by 15% for 20 s. While affected by [Shrouded in Mist] , the shield absorbs damage up to 18% max HP instead, and stamina consumption is reduced by 18% for 30 s.

Inhales to trigger an explosion that deals AoE damage. Increases the entire team's damage and BREAK efficiency by 15% for 20 s. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist] , the damage and BREAK efficiency boost also applies to all nearby allies, with the boost increased to 30% .

innate.d: (Ultimate) Turbo sneezes, shaking 7 collectibles out of its wool. Picking up a collectible restores 6% HP.
Wields the power of wind to attack targets from a distance.

upgrades.d: Inhales to trigger an explosion that deals AoE damage. Increases the entire team's damage and BREAK efficiency by 15% for 20 s. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist] , the damage and BREAK efficiency boost also applies to all nearby allies, with the boost increased to 30% .

log: They like to sleep hidden in the clouds, because with the presence of wind pressure and static electricity, the fluffy wool easily attracts things carried by the winds.

name: Veilfloat

traits.d: Teammates who receive this Aniimo's skill buff also gain a 15% of ATK Lightning boost for 20 s.
Increases healing by 10%.
While in battle, the next skill grants an additional 25 Ultimate Points. Can trigger once every 15s.

skills.d: Quickly retreats, leaving behind a jellyfish clone that releases a wave of Lightning energy to attack targets and slow them by 15% for 10 s.
Fires an energy beam. Hold the skill button to keep firing, damaging targets within range and healing Lightning-type teammates within range for 2% HP every second.

innate.d: Wields the power of lightning to attack targets from a distance.

log: A light-dependent creature that glows when night falls, keeping its light on even while sleeping.

name: Waleetle

traits.d: Increases ATK by 12% for 15s when entering battle.
Moving and using skills builds [Overload Energy] . When fully charged, the next skill deals 40% extra damage and immediately brings [Sandstorm Spin] to maximum speed.

skills.d: Raises the stone ball and rolls forward, dealing a large amount of damage.
Spins around to deal damage to a target in front. Each hit increases damage by 8% for 20 s, stacking up to 4 times.
Spins around by continuously consuming EP, dealing damage. Deals 20% extra damage to BREAK targets. Spin speed gradually increases, raising damage frequency by up to 100% without increasing EP cost.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Launches a giant rock ball forward. The rock ball rolls over targets in its path and explodes.
Wields the power of earth to attack targets at close range.

upgrades.d: Spins around by continuously consuming EP, dealing damage. Deals 20% extra damage to BREAK targets. Spin speed gradually increases, raising damage frequency by up to 100% without increasing EP cost.

log: They move backwards like their kin, but in a much fancier way.

name: Wavwal

traits.d: After casting 3 skills, enhances the next skill used during Icebreaker and adds an extra effect. When HP is below 75% , increases BREAK efficiency by 20% . When HP is below 50% , increases BREAK efficiency by 40% .

skills.d: Leaps toward the target and slams down, dealing circular AoE damage. When enhanced, gains an Ice Shield equal to 10% of max HP and creates a ring-shaped Ice Prison around the target for 8 s. Recast to cancel the Ice Prison.
Charges in the selected direction, knocking back targets and dealing damage. Hitting any target consumes 10% of current HP.
Slides across the ice, dealing AoE damage in front. When enhanced, performs an additional spin, dealing damage equal to 40% of the original Might and restoring 15% of max HP for each target hit.

innate.d: (Ultimate) Grants all nearby allies a Shield equal to 55% of Wavwal's missing HP for 20 s.
(BREAK) Wields the power of ice to attack targets at close range.

log: They move clumsily on land using their four limbs, but they are experts at sliding on their bellies. The males are highly territorial against other males, once angered, they unleash their wrath like a tsunami.

name: Wisptis

traits.d: When attacking targets not in combat, increases BREAK damage dealt by 50% for 15s.
Defeating a target grants 1 stack of Battlelust , increasing damage by 25% for 20 s. Stacks up to 2 times.

skills.d: Tackles the target with the power of shadows, increasing basic attack damage by 40% for 10 s after casting.
Spins to slash, dealing Dark damage 4 times to all nearby targets. Each hit increases own damage by 4% , up to 32% , for 10 s.

innate.d: Wields dark power to attack targets at close range.

log: If the only way to evolve is to defeat other Wisptises, then there is no other choice but to keep their claws sharp.
